# OpenHub

OpenHub is a hosted account + project service at https://openhub.run.
Each project stores a git working tree and an agent session log.
v1 is owner-only. There are no pull requests, issues, or anonymous push.

## Docs

- Guide: https://openhub.run/docs/guide.md
- Changelog: https://openhub.run/docs/changelog.md
- Human HTML: https://openhub.run/help
- Index: https://openhub.run/llms.txt
